QB.name: Quarterback
QB.job: Takes the snap and decides: hand the ball off, throw it, or run with it. The leader of the offense.

RB.name: Running back
RB.job: Lines up behind the quarterback. Takes handoffs and runs with the ball, or catches short passes.

WR.name: Wide receiver
WR.job: Lines up wide, runs a route, and catches passes. Fast and good with their hands.

TE.name: Tight end
TE.job: Lines up next to the tackle. Half blocker, half receiver.

C.name: Center
C.job: Snaps the ball to the quarterback, then blocks. The middle of the offensive line.

G.name: Guard
G.job: Lines up next to the center and blocks for runs and passes.

T.name: Tackle
T.job: The outside blocker on the line. Protects the quarterback's blind side on passes.

DE.name: Defensive end
DE.job: Lines up on the end of the defensive line. Rushes the passer and sets the edge against runs.

DT.name: Defensive tackle
DT.job: The big player in the middle of the line. Plugs running lanes and pushes the pocket.

LB.name: Linebacker
LB.job: Lines up behind the line. Tackles runners, covers short passes, and sometimes blitzes.

CB.name: Cornerback
CB.job: Covers the wide receivers. Fast, and tries to stop catches.

S.name: Safety
S.job: The last line of defense. Lines up deep and helps against long passes and big runs.

R.name: Rusher
R.job: In flag football, the one defender allowed to chase the quarterback. Starts 7 yards back.

D.name: Defender
D.job: In flag football, covers a receiver or a zone and pulls the flag of the ball carrier.

FB.name: Fullback
FB.job: Lines up in front of the running back. A blocker first: leads the way through the hole and clears out a linebacker.

NT.name: Nose tackle
NT.job: Lines up right over the center in a 3-4 defense. The biggest player on the field, built to clog the middle.

K.name: Kicker
K.job: Kicks off, kicks field goals, and kicks extra points. Has to be calm with the whole stadium watching.

P.name: Punter
P.job: On fourth down, catches the long snap and kicks the ball high and far so the other team starts a long way from your end zone.

LS.name: Long snapper
LS.job: Snaps the ball 7 yards to the holder or 14 yards to the punter, fast and perfectly straight, then blocks.

H.name: Holder
H.job: Catches the snap, puts the ball on the ground with the laces out, and holds it steady for the kicker.

W.name: Wing
W.job: Lines up just outside the line on kicks and punts. Blocks the rusher coming around the edge.

PP.name: Personal protector
PP.job: Stands in front of the punter, calls out the blocking, and stops any rusher who gets through.

GN.name: Gunner
GN.job: Lines up out wide on a punt. Sprints down the field the moment the ball is snapped to tackle the returner.

CV.name: Coverage player
CV.job: Runs down the field on a kickoff in a lane, stays in that lane, and tackles the returner.

KR.name: Kick returner
KR.job: Stands deep, catches the kickoff, and runs it back behind the blockers. Fast and brave.

PR.name: Punt returner
PR.job: Catches the punt, or waves for a fair catch when the gunners are too close, then runs it back.

BL.name: Return blocker
BL.job: Drops back and blocks a coverage player so the returner has a lane to run through.

J.name: Jammer
J.job: Lines up right across from the gunner and slows him down at the line so he cannot get to the returner first.

RS.name: Rusher
RS.job: On a punt or field goal, charges through the line and tries to block the kick with his hands.
